entities.name: Scaleway
entities.description: European sovereign cloud and AI provider announcing a product-by-product price increase effective June 1st 2026.
anchors: held prices flat for three years
motives: maintain long-term viability while preserving customer trust

entities.name: June 2026 price increase
entities.description: Targeted price adjustments across compute, storage, network and bare-metal products taking effect June 1st 2026.
anchors: product-by-product analysis, not a blanket hike
motives: cover rising hardware and network costs

entities.name: STARDUST1-S
entities.description: Entry-level compute instance rising from €0.00015 to €0.0006 per hour, a fourfold increase.

entities.name: Serverless memory pricing
entities.description: Serverless Jobs, Containers and Functions memory roughly doubling per GB-second.

entities.name: DNS zones for external domains
entities.description: DNS zone pricing rising from €0.001 to €0.007 per hour, a sevenfold increase.

entities.name: Dedibox bare metal
entities.description: Dedicated bare-metal servers rising roughly 15 to 17 percent monthly.

entities.name: GPU instances
entities.description: H100, L40S and L4 GPU instances rising about 5 to 10 percent per hour.

entities.name: Key Manager version storage
entities.description: Secret version storage rising from €0.04 to €0.06 per key per month.

entities.name: Public Gateways and Load Balancers
entities.description: Network products repriced toward specialized value, e.g. Load Balancer GP-S €0.016 to €0.023 per hour.

entities.name: Hardware cost crisis
entities.description: Surging raw hardware, storage, RAM and IP shortage costs cited as the driver.
anchors: price surges in raw hardware, particularly storage and RAM

entities.name: Three years of flat prices
entities.description: The vendor's claim to have absorbed costs for three years while investing.
anchors: held prices flat for three years
absorbing the growing global pressures entirely

entities.name: Partnership framing
entities.description: The announcement's framing of vendor and customers as true partners sharing wins and realities.
anchors: the relationship with our customers is a true partnership
